mapper.select: SELECT * FROM source_document WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND source_type = 'feishu' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(metadata_json, '$.documentKind')) = 'FILE' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(metadata_json, '$.rootDocumentId')) = #{rootDocumentId} AND ( (#{providerItemId} <> '' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(metadata_json, '$.providerItemId')) = #{providerItemId}) OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(metadata_json, '$.fileIdentityHash')) IN (#{fileIdentityHash}, #{pathIdentityHash}) OR (#{sourcePath} <> '' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(metadata_json, '$.sourcePath')) = #{sourcePath}) ) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT root_doc.* FROM source_document root_doc WHERE root_doc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND root_doc.sync_status <> 'archived' AND (root_doc.metadata_json IS NULL OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(root_doc.metadata_json, '$.documentKind')) <> 'FILE')
AND (root_doc.created_by = #{viewerSubjectId} OR root_doc.permission_scope IN ('TEACHER_SHARED', 'TENANT_PUBLIC', 'PUBLIC_TEXTBOOK', 'MATH_VIP', 'CLASS_AUTHORIZED'))
AND root_doc.permission_scope IN ('TENANT_PUBLIC', 'PUBLIC_TEXTBOOK', 'MATH_VIP', 'CLASS_AUTHORIZED')
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY root_doc.title ASC, root_doc.id ASC

SELECT file_doc.* FROM source_document file_doc WHERE file_doc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file_doc.source_type = 'feishu' AND file_doc.sync_status <> 'archived' AND file_doc.parse_status IN ('parsed', 'completed') AND file_doc.embedding_status IN ('ready', 'completed') AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(file_doc.metadata_json, '$.documentKind')) = 'FILE' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(file_doc.metadata_json, '$.rootDocumentId')) IN #{rootId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM source_document root_doc WHERE root_doc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND root_doc.id = CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(file_doc.metadata_json, '$.rootDocumentId')) AS UNSIGNED) AND root_doc.sync_status <> 'archived' )
AND (file_doc.created_by = #{viewerSubjectId} OR file_doc.permission_scope IN ('TEACHER_SHARED', 'TENANT_PUBLIC', 'PUBLIC_TEXTBOOK', 'MATH_VIP', 'CLASS_AUTHORIZED'))
AND file_doc.permission_scope IN ('TENANT_PUBLIC', 'PUBLIC_TEXTBOOK', 'MATH_VIP', 'CLASS_AUTHORIZED')
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY file_doc.title ASC, file_doc.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT file_doc.* FROM source_document file_doc WHERE file_doc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file_doc.source_type = 'feishu' AND file_doc.sync_status <> 'archived' AND file_doc.parse_status IN ('parsed', 'completed') AND file_doc.embedding_status IN ('ready', 'completed') AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(file_doc.metadata_json, '$.documentKind')) = 'FILE' AND file_doc.id IN CAST(#{fileId} AS UNSIGNED)
AND (file_doc.created_by = #{viewerSubjectId} OR file_doc.permission_scope IN ('TEACHER_SHARED', 'TENANT_PUBLIC', 'PUBLIC_TEXTBOOK', 'MATH_VIP', 'CLASS_AUTHORIZED'))
AND file_doc.permission_scope IN ('TENANT_PUBLIC', 'PUBLIC_TEXTBOOK', 'MATH_VIP', 'CLASS_AUTHORIZED')
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY file_doc.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE source_document SET sync_status = 'archived', parse_status = 'archived', embedding_status = 'archived', metadata_json = JSON_SET(COALESCE(metadata_json, '{}'), '$.indexStatus', 'archived') WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{fileDocumentId} AND source_type = 'feishu' AND sync_status <> 'archived' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(metadata_json, '$.documentKind')) = 'FILE'
